Subject: one small soft rounded storm cloud in pale ice and sky-blue tones with gentle navy-blue underside shading, and one tiny warm-orange rounded lightning bolt below it. Calm, not threatening. No rain, no face on the cloud, no other objects.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide landscape CircleU app header scene, fully opaque, no transparency. Match the supplied CircleU artwork reference: clean smooth rounded geometric silhouettes, sophisticated matte 2D editorial illustration with gentle restrained shading, upper-left light, suitable for students and young adults. Palette navy #0D1421, royal blue #054FC9, ice #F5FAFF, sky #47C7FF, small warm orange #FF8538 accents. No sketch lines, hatching, texture, grain, outlines, glossy plastic, clay, photorealism, text, lettering, watermark, frame or border. Calm, quiet and soft, not cheerful-loud; low contrast, gentle gradients, few elements. Wide landscape composition about 2:1; keep all important content inside the central horizontal band so the top and bottom can be cropped slightly. The bottom 15% of the image is a calm plain flat tone of pale ice-blue water close to #E3EEFF with no objects, ripples or detail, blending softly. Character identity reference: BrandAvatar.png. Preserve EXACT same recognisable Pingu identity, one curved crest, navy head/body, white heart-shaped face and belly, small oval dark eyes, tiny closed orange beak, icy blue scarf, plump proportions, orange feet. Same gentle dimensional shading as reference; do not redesign its face, add eyebrows, blush, clothes or props except those requested. Scene: Pingu sitting calmly on a small rounded ice floe on a calm sea, soft pale morning sky with gentle sky-blue and faint warm-orange dawn glow, very gentle low hills of ice far in the background. Pingu and floe sit in the left 45% of the width. The right 40% is quiet empty sky and sea with nothing in it. Pingu looks calm and content, small in the frame (about 45% of image height).
